name: gout-strict-response-representation-profiles
instr:
gout cannot currently enforce consistent response-decoding policies across BodyDecode, JSONDecode, XMLDecode, and YAMLDecode. Add disabled, structural, and exact policies that propagate from Client defaults into new DataFlow instances without changing disabled-mode behavior.

Make strict decoding transactional: representation-policy failures leave all targets unchanged, occur before validation, and return DecodePolicyError with the format, DecodeRule, and any underlying parser error. Structural mode rejects JSON duplicate members, XML repeated singleton elements, and YAML duplicate keys. Declared XML slices remain repeatable. RejectUnknownFields, RejectAliases, and RejectMergeKeys control their corresponding rules, including alias-based YAML merges.

Exact mode also rejects extra JSON values, extra XML or YAML documents, and trailing non-space scalar body data. Preserve existing complete byte and string body and writer-streaming semantics.

Apply one DataFlow policy to every binding and callback path, including PolicyDecoder implementations, while supporting legacy Decoder implementations. Isolate flow overrides. Preserve policies through middleware and callback rebinding. Req.Reset discards only per-flow state. Debug replay and response middleware must expose the same final representation without consuming it, changing outcomes, or reclassifying middleware failures.

Late JSON duplicates in multi-decoder flows preserve all initial targets and precede validation. Failed flow
